QF.id: SIA Case Studies on SAS Standards_39

question.text: A plantation project reports trees planted and an estimated amount of carbon sequestration. Under SAS-500, the SIA should:

answer.text: Accept the reported number at face value
Divide the reported number by 10 arbitrarily
Verify the donor indicators - number of trees, tree species, mortality and the amount of carbon sequestration - through desk review of records and physical inspection of project assets where relevant
Multiply the reported number by 2 for safety

explanation.text: The Logic: Workbook donor indicators for tree-plantation projects include number of trees, tree species, mortality and the amount of carbon sequestration. The SAS-500 IWMP case supports desk review of project records and physical inspection of project assets as means of verification. The SIA should verify each of these indicators on that basis. The Trap: Accepting reported numbers at face value (A) or applying arbitrary adjustments (B, D) is not source-backed verification. Note: Tie the verification working paper to the donor indicator list - trees, species, mortality, sequestration amount - and record the evidence source for each (records reviewed and inspections done).
